s1.syndrome_frame: Subacute onset of systemic illness with fever, weakness, abdominal pain, and bleeding, accompanied by hepatosplenomegaly and pancytopenia
salient_findings: Pancytopenia with abnormal blastoid cells on peripheral smear
Bilateral subdural hemorrhages and pleural effusions
Bone marrow showing trilineage dysplasia and erythrophagocytosis
key_facts: 39-year-old man with history of treated tuberculosis
Two weeks of fever, generalized weakness, and abdominal pain
Vomiting, headache, body aches, and moderate nasal bleeding
2×1 cm submandibular lymph node and hepatomegaly (7 cm below the costal margin)
Urea 18.8 mmol/L, creatinine 141 µmol/L, and elevated lipase
Pancytopenia with hemoglobin 6.4 g/dL, WBC 1.7×10^3/µL, and platelets 2×10^3/µL
Negative viral serologies
Bone marrow aspirate showing 26% immature metachromatic blasts
Trilineage dysplasia with megaloblastic changes and dysplastic megakaryocytes
Erythrophagocytosis by histiocytes and atypical cells

per_call: Systemic Lupus Erythematosus with Hemophagocytic Lymphohistiocytosis

shortlist.label: Hemophagocytic Lymphohistiocytosis
shortlist.why_kept: Erythrophagocytosis by histiocytes and atypical cells, fever, hepatosplenomegaly, and pancytopenia

shortlist.label: Acute Myeloid Leukemia
shortlist.why_kept: Pancytopenia, abnormal blastoid cells, and trilineage dysplasia in bone marrow aspirate

shortlist.label: Myelodysplastic Syndrome
shortlist.why_kept: Trilineage dysplasia, megaloblastic changes, and dysplastic megakaryocytes in bone marrow aspirate

shortlist.label: Subacute Myelomonocytic Leukemia
shortlist.why_kept: Pancytopenia, abnormal blastoid cells, and monocytosis

shortlist.label: Blastic Plasmacytoid Dendritic Cell Neoplasm
shortlist.why_kept: Abnormal blastoid cells with coarse basophilic granules and bilobed nuclei

raw.rationale: The patient's presentation with fever, hepatomegaly, splenomegaly, pancytopenia, and elevated ferritin levels, along with the bone marrow findings of erythrophagocytosis by histiocytes and atypical cells, are highly suggestive of Hemophagocytic Lymphohistiocytosis.

rejected.label: Acute Myeloid Leukemia
rejected.why: While the bone marrow aspirate shows immature blasts, the presence of trilineage dysplasia and erythrophagocytosis points more towards a diagnosis of Hemophagocytic Lymphohistiocytosis.

rejected.label: Myelodysplastic Syndrome
rejected.why: The patient's symptoms and laboratory findings, such as pancytopenia and elevated ferritin, are not typical for Myelodysplastic Syndrome.

rejected.label: Subacute Myelomonocytic Leukemia
rejected.why: The patient's bone marrow findings and clinical presentation do not align with Subacute Myelomonocytic Leukemia.

rejected.label: Blastic Plasmacytoid Dendritic Cell Neoplasm
rejected.why: The patient's laboratory findings and bone marrow results do not support a diagnosis of Blastic Plasmacytoid Dendritic Cell Neoplasm.
